verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents a general vault export (JSON/CSV) for 'logins and notes' and back-up/transfer purposes, but the evidence never explicitly confirms that TOTP secrets are included in that export or specifies an open, human-readable format for them — only import paths for other authenticators (Google Authenticator QR, LastPass JSON, 2FAS) are detailed, which is the opposite direction (lock-in mitigation on entry, not exit). Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that TOTP seeds are present in the standard export file, documentation of the exact readable TOTP export format, and any independent/hands-on verification that exported TOTP secrets can be reimported elsewhere.
